carlos.sales: Quick sync  NeoPay (payments stack) asked for a 3-week BYOK POC. Key asks: keys must be generated inside their on-prem Luna HSM and never exportable; split custody (two-person approval) for any key use above threshold; rotation every 90 days but they want a nightly auto-check to verify key health; audit streaming into their SIEM; and option for Redwood Dedicated vs Private. Can we confirm operational constraints and rough pricing impact?
meera.solutions: Important clarifying q: when you say split custody, do they mean HSM-local M of N (i.e., HSM enforces dual-operator unseal) or an external quorum/escrow workflow? That changes what we can automate.
sophia.neopay: We want dual-operator enforced by our HSM (M-of-N) for key material creation and any high-priv ops. Redwood should never be a custodian or have the ability to unwrap without our co-sign. We can expose a PKCS#11 endpoint inside our peered VPC. Also need SAML-based auth for the Redwood service principal and TLS mutual auth.
yuki.crypto: We support HSM-enforced M-of-N if the customer performs key generation inside their device and exposes a PKCS#11 endpoint. For any ops requiring dual-approval, Redwood can surface an approval workflow but final unseal happens on their HSM. Network path: VPC peering + route filter or private link, no public egress.
meera.solutions: Network checklist for NeoPay ops team: CIDR allowlist, FQDN for the HSM proxy, mTLS client cert for Redwood, SAML metadata for the service principal, and a short bastion window for connectivity tests. Please also confirm expected peak KMS ops and p99 latency requirement.
carlos.sales: NeoPay says p95 ~60ms, p99 under 160ms, peak ~200 ops/sec (payment auth traffic). They also want nightly health check logs and a weekly key-status report pushed to their SIEM.
yuki.crypto: 200 ops/sec is moderate; we need to verify concurrency and seq length of KMS operations, but PKCS#11 path should handle it with our pooling. Notes: 1) We cannot cache plaintext keys; every unseal must occur via the HSM. 2) For rotation with zero-downtime, we support an overlap window where we accept both keys; with their M-of-N requirement they must coordinate generating the new key and enabling it in the HSM.
sophia.neopay: We'll produce a rotation runbook showing the M-of-N key generate + publish flow. For rollback, we require the ability to re-enable old key for up to 48h. Also ask: do you support firmware attestation checks before accepting HSM endpoints?
yuki.crypto: We can require vendor-signed attestation tokens (if the HSM supports it). That would be listed as an onboarding preflight item. Vendors we validate: Thales Luna, Utimaco, and Gemalto (PKCS#11). Please include HSM firmware version, module checksum, and attestation token if available.
ops-bot: Runbook created: /runbooks/sales/neopay-mofn-byok-poc  template includes split-custody checklist, SAML setup guide, connectivity tests, and contact matrix.
meera.solutions: Send these connectivity tests to NeoPay bastion team:
```bash
# from customer bastion -> proposed HSM proxy
openssl s_client -connect hsm-proxy.neopay.internal:443 -servername hsm.neopay.internal -cert client.pem -key client.key
# simple TCP check
nc -vz hsm-proxy.neopay.internal 443
```
billing-team: Heads-up: BYOK with on-prem HSM proxy and split-custody adds a one-time integration engineering effort and a compliance validation fee. Dedicated pricing typically gives lower per-op cost but requires commit; Private has higher baseline. I'll sketch a delta and post by EOD.
yuki.crypto: Also request expected peak concurrency, whether they will sign import requests or do in-HSM generation, and whether they need any HSM-side cron for nightly health checks (we can forward those logs).
sophia.neopay: We'll provide bastion window Thursday 08:00 PT, vendor docs, and our M-of-N policy. Action items: 1) @meera.solutions draft SOW with split-custody rotation playbook, rollback, and attestation requirements. 2) @yuki.crypto produce vendor compatibility notes and exact latency targets under load. 3) @billing-team post onboarding + monthly delta for Dedicated vs Private incl. compliance fee. 4) @sophia.neopay send CIDRs, bastion access window, and vendor attestation docs.
carlos.sales: Thanks all 680. If preflight is clean we'll target a 3-week POC window and a follow-up for Dedicated sizing.
legal-bot: Legal will review proposed SOW language for "no Redwood custody" and the escrow-only-under-court-order clause. Also flag any export-control or cross-border concerns with attestation tokens.
meera.solutions: Great  I'll populate the runbook and ping legal once SOW draft is attached. Let's aim to have the pricing delta and SOW draft before Thursday preflight.
